name: Grown-Man Fanboy
qaNote: Reference inspected. Preserve adult fan with outward locs, square glasses, small goatee, stained cream tee/gray jeans, light sneakers, little wooden fan, paper and marker. Review interception, prop/hand count and exact apostrophe/title.

result.prompt:
Create an EPIC 8-second illustrated fighting-game super finisher, portrait 9:16. Bold hand-inked outlines, rich cel shading, dynamic comic-book perspective, exaggerated scale and explosive acceleration. Reference image defines the exact character identity, face, costume, colors and props, NOT the background or initial camera crop. Preserve the illustrated character; no live-action or 3D makeover. Make a complete miniature action scene with a surprising payoff and a charismatic ending, not an idle animation with particles.
CAMERA AND COMPOSITING: cinematic camera motion is encouraged: dramatic pullbacks to reveal impossible scale, depth travel and deliberate close-ups. Establish the complete character early and return to a clear hero composition. Keep face and anatomy correct; intentional close-up crops are fine, accidental chopped limbs in a wide shot are not. The unoccupied backing remains perfectly flat pure cyan #00FFFF in EVERY shot, including close-ups. No scenery, floor plane, opaque rectangular manga panel, background gradient, vignette or full-frame whiteout. Use foreground objects and perspective to communicate distance. Large impact stars and disconnected tapered speed strokes terminate naturally on cyan instead of connecting to image borders. Warm effect colors with ink edges; no cyan/turquoise glow that will disappear under chroma key. No crowns.
TEXT: one exact move title, thick uppercase comic lettering, warm white-to-gold fill, chunky black outline and dark offset extrusion, angled forceful slam with brief overshoot and settle. Stable readable spelling, intelligently placed away from the face, no additional captions or words. A title arrival is an impact beat of its own.
SOUND: strong synchronized anticipation, accelerating whooshes, exaggerated action hits, one dominant payoff, and a short settling tail. No music, speech or narration.

Grown-Man Fanboy — He Doesn’t Know You.
IDENTITY: exact adult Black man with outward-pointing short locs, large square black glasses, small chin goatee, huge eager grin, loose cream T-shirt, stained gray jeans and light gray/white sneakers. Preserve his little tan hand fan, plain white autograph sheet and thick black marker. Keep existing stains and proportions. No new celebrity or second human.
0–1.2s: complete character leans eagerly toward one small floating gold FIST-shaped idol badge, offering his blank autograph sheet and marker with an embarrassingly hopeful grin. The badge is an inanimate game emblem, not a person's face or portrait.
1.2–3.2s: a colossal red-and-black attack comet streaks toward the badge from far in depth. He spots it, shoves his paper and marker safely against his chest, then bursts into a thirty-foot sprint as camera races low beside his shoes. He throws his whole body between the attack and his idol, raising the tiny tan fan as if it could possibly help. Strong heroic leap and determined expression, all against flat cyan.
3.2–4.8s: the comet SLAMS into his block. An enormous warm-gold shield silhouette shaped like his outstretched arms erupts behind him, catching the entire impact. Camera pulls impossibly wide as the collision shoves him backward through empty cyan, sneakers bicycling, then he digs into a braced midair stance and bats the comet away with one furious little fan swipe. Huge black/red fragments peel away, the gold badge remains untouched behind him. One dominant cinematic BOOM and readable blocking hold; no ground, buildings, blood or other characters.
4.8–6s: snap-zoom to his glasses and ridiculously proud grin. Exact title HE DOESN'T KNOW YOU slams below his face in three bold stable comic lines.
6–8s: he resumes offering the perfectly preserved blank autograph sheet and marker to the idol badge. It drifts casually away without responding. His grin falters for a beat, then he frantically waves the tiny hand fan like this might get its attention. End in a clear full-body pose, title stable. SFX: paper rustle, charging comet whine, explosive sneaker rush, huge shield impact, sharp fan deflection, fading air whistle and one lonely paper flap. No voice, music, crowd or extra written words.
